the proposed method can segment images more accurately, with better quality than other methods.
the proposed method can be used to segment the image into regions with high accuracy and low over-segmentation, which is the key problem in the watershed segmentation.

marker controlled watershed segmentation is more efficient than watershed segmentation in terms of over-segmentation and the use of morphological markers is more efficient than the use of gradient images in terms of number regions segmented.

the improvement of segmentation quality by reducing the number of regions obtained.
the improvement of segmentation quality by using morphological marker controlled watershed algorithm and the use of the gradient image for segmentation.
the improvement of watershed segmentation method by controlling the number of markers and the use of morphological gradient to minimize over-segments.

, the proposed approach of marker controlled watershed algorithm with gradient image is an effective and efficient method to segment the image.

the proposed method is better than the traditional method of watershed segmentation in the context of over-segmentation and it is also better than the marker controlled method in the context of under-segmentation.
the proposed method is better than the existing method in the sense of less over-segmentation and better segmentation of the image.

the proposed approach has shown a good performance and the results have been compared with the other existing approaches.
the marker controlled method is superior to the gradient image method in terms of the accuracy of segmentation.
the proposed method is a robust one to segment images with different intensity levels.

the proposed method is robust and can be implemented on a large scale.
